data.name: Deveshansh
data.gender_notes: Deveshansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deveshansh is a combination of two Sanskrit words: 'Deva' (God) and 'Shansh' (Gift). This name symbolizes the graceful gift bestowed by the gods upon a child. The name Deveshansh carries the meaning “God's Graceful Gift” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deveshansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's graceful gift and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Deveshansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Graceful Gift.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deveshansh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
